flow.name: github-repo-setup-flow
flow.doc:name: GitHub Repo Setup Flow
flow.doc:description: Creates feature branch, injects SAP Connector dep into pom.xml, upgrades SAP config in global.xml to Message Server format with Extended Properties

mcp:tool-listener.name: github-repo-setup
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: Accepts repoName; creates feature branch, adds SAP Connector dep to pom.xml, upgrades SAP global.xml config to Message Server format
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Sets up a GitHub repository: creates feature/add-sap-dependency branch, injects the MuleSoft SAP Connector dependency into pom.xml, and upgrades sap:sap-config in global.xml to Message Server format with inline Extended Properties (jco.client.mshost, jco.client.msserv, jco.client.group, jco.client.saprouter). ALWAYS ask the user for the repository name before invoking.

choice.doc:name: repoName present?
choice.doc:description: Safety guard - repoName must be supplied

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- {error:"repoName is required",message:"Always ask the user for the repository name.",example:{repoName:"my-mule-project"}}

otherwise.doc:name: Run GitHub SAP Setup
otherwise.doc:description: Runs the full SAP setup workflow

http:request.doc:name: Search GitHub Repo
http:request.doc:description: Searches GitHub API for the repository

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- {success:false,error:"Not Found",message:"Repository '" ++ vars.repoName ++ "' not found on GitHub."}

otherwise.doc:name: Found - Proceed
otherwise.doc:description: Extracts metadata and proceeds with SAP setup

ee:transform.doc:name: Extract Repo Metadata
ee:transform.doc:description: Extracts owner, name, default branch and URL

http:request.doc:name: Fetch pom.xml
http:request.doc:description: Retrieves pom.xml from the feature branch

set-variable.doc:name: pom.xml SHA
set-variable.doc:description: pom.xml blob SHA for GitHub PUT

ee:transform.doc:name: Inject SAP Connector Dependency into pom.xml
ee:transform.doc:description: Decodes pom.xml, inserts MuleSoft SAP Connector dependency block before closing dependencies tag, re-encodes for GitHub commit

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/java
var raw=((payload.content as String) replace "
" with "" replace " " with "")
var pom=fromBase64(raw) as String {encoding:"UTF-8"}
var sap="
        <!-- MuleSoft SAP Connector - Added by github-repo-setup MCP Tool -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.mulesoft.connectors</groupId>
            <artifactId>mule-sap-connector</artifactId>
            <version>4.3.0</version>
            <classifier>mule-plugin</classifier>
        </dependency>"
var up=pom replace "</dependencies>" with (sap++"
    </dependencies>")
--- {encoded:toBase64(up as Binary {encoding:"UTF-8"})}

http:request.doc:name: Commit Updated pom.xml
http:request.doc:description: Commits pom.xml with SAP Connector dependency to the feature branch
http:request.http:body: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- {"message":"chore: add MuleSoft SAP Connector dependency to pom.xml","content":payload.encoded,"sha":vars.pomFileSha,"branch":p('feature.branch.name')}]

set-variable.doc:name: pom Commit SHA
set-variable.doc:description: Commit SHA returned after pom.xml update

flow-ref.name: upgrade-sap-config-subflow
flow-ref.doc:name: Upgrade SAP Config in global.xml
flow-ref.doc:description: Calls sub-flow to upgrade SAP connection in global.xml from Application Server to Message Server format

ee:transform.doc:name: Build Success Result
ee:transform.doc:description: Returns structured JSON summary of all changes made to the repository
